content: During the distillation of the teacher BERT model to train the student BERT language model, we utilize the same corpus as was used to train the teacher i.e. BooksCorpus BIBREF37 and English Wikipedia, with whitespaces used tokenize the text into words. We only use the masked language modeling task to calculate the overall distillation loss from Section SECREF6, since the next sentence prediction loss hurt performance slightly. Dual training is enabled for teacher model inputs, with $p_{DT}$, the probability of segmenting a teacher model input word using the student vocabulary, set to 0.5. For experiments including shared projection, the projection matrices $\mathbf {U}$ and $\mathbf {V}$ utilized Xavier initialization BIBREF38. The loss weight coefficient $\epsilon $ is set to 1 after tuning.
